system.description: Criminals commonly craft crude weapons for themselves or steal them from their betters. Flashing Wires have found that they are quicker to surrender once relieved of such dubious support. Channeling a quick snap of Essence, the martial artist's whip flashes through the air to curl around a criminal's weapon, disarming him in a burst of sparks. When used to supplement a disarm attempt, this Charm converts the standard disarming bonus of the character's whip into automatic successes and doubles the length the weapon is thrown. TANGLED WEAVER'S TRAP
